items.title: Bella Cornish Interview
items.q: And he said when they took Buddy Bowling, when they put him in the crazy house, he died, you know. He died in the crazy house.

ctx.x: That's what Dr. Shae's wife might have it.

Somebody died. I said one day I was going to go down there and inquire for him. He gave me that, and he told me, he told me, don't come under a month. But when the month was up, I went. I said, now I done give that man that nice picture. And Willie told me he was the oldest one, had one left, said all of them had one when they all come in dying out. And he said when they took Buddy Bowling, when they put him in the crazy house, he died, you know. He died in the crazy house.
Did you ever hear your husband say anything about making a record with that band?
